title: DiscoveryProfile
description: Immutable, bounded discovery profile for one asset version + parser/options fingerprint. Missing values stay missing; discovery must complete without an LLM.

parserFingerprint.description: Hash of parser version + requested profile options.

status.description: indexing_required: population needs the existing logical index which is not ready. unsupported/protected/corrupt are terminal and actionable; they are never retried automatically.

structure.description: Format structure only — sheets/tables/ranges for tabular sources, outline/section counts for documents.

samples.description: Bounded prefix rows/blocks. Sample scope is explicitly bounded and never counts as full-dataset coverage.

semanticFindings.description: Optional; may be empty in R1. Generated descriptions guide discovery and never prove a business fact by themselves.

completeProfileDone.description: True only after full eligible-scope enumeration; exact counts require it.
